# The absent event in the notebook

The museum did not phone Jo during her holiday because the fallback sheet worked. That absence is hard to record without making a claim about every possible cause. [[Maintenance]]: note the prediction and the observed interval, not a triumphant assertion that we solved dependence forever. Another failure mode may still be waiting.
